title: Eco-design audit of every pull request
summary: A workflow that runs the audit of green-claude (eco-design rules drawn from RGESN and GR491) at a pinned commit on what each pull request changes, reports the findings it adds as annotations and in the job summary, and fails only past a level the project sets. Nothing is copied from the plugin.
postInstall: The workflow fetches green-claude at the commit in scripts/eco-design.config.json and runs it on every pull request: the kit's authors read it at that commit; read it yourself, or put a commit you have read there (docs/conventions/eco-design.md § Bumping the pin).
Advisory until fail_on is set in scripts/eco-design.config.json; a failing check holds a merge only once Eco-design audit is a required check of the default branch's ruleset.
Run the workflow once by hand on the default branch: it lists the findings already there, which pull requests are not charged with.
The workflow has never run live: do the live check of docs/conventions/eco-design.md on its first pull request.
